The Collection

Stays that belong to the mountains.

Allure Casa offers vacation residences in Murree built around space, mountain outlooks and quiet. Our flagship, Allure Casa 02, is a three-bedroom apartment near MIT on Lower Jhika Gali Road, made for couples and families. We also have apartments in Islamabad.

Guests rate the stay 4.81 out of 5 across 63 reviews, and most often praise the hospitality, the location and the views.

The Surroundings

Above the city. Closer to the mountains.

Murree is a hill station in the foothills of Punjab, known for snowy winters, tea houses, cool air and winding roads above the plains. Allure Casa 02 sits near Jhika Gali, a short drive from the bazaar and Mall Road.

Guests rate the location 4.9 out of 5.
